description:
**Original Webtoon: **  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1515019145), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6375868), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/heartvoice), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/inner_voice), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000049992), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=210433), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/Voice_of_Mind), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/5928), [MComics](https://www.mcomics.co.kr/webtoonComic/8373), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=nreg)

Si-eun, who lost her hearing in an accident and was exhausted with emotions, cannot hear the sound, but can hear the sound of the other person's earnest heart.  
Si-eun, who entered Choi Si-hyuk's secretary at the request of his biological grandfather-like mj chairman, opened her heart little by little to Si-hyuk,  
Sihyuk is trying to use Sieun like that...
